maintenance_led.reason: Connectors, anchors and fasteners (Simpson Strong-Tie) are mostly installed in new residential and commercial construction, not repair or replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are homebuilders, contractors and distributors serving private residential and commercial construction, not government-paid work.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly comes from selling its own structural connector, anchor and fastening products; acquisitions are occasional, e.g. Gridmarq, ETANCO.

mission_critical.reason: Code-listed, engineer-specified structural connectors are qualified into building designs; switching needs re-engineering and code approval.
